summary: Frontend-only SEO regression at http://localhost:3000 (desktop 1920 + mobile 390). Checked all 12 routes for one H1, title length, canonical, JSON-LD parsing and breadcrumbs; 404 page; group-tours redirect; index.html @graph and logo; Services details, links and ItemList; Home internal links; RelatedGuides; hero/slot srcset; reviews; overflow. Almost everything passes. One failure: the Home title is 61 characters, which is over the 60-character limit. One minor issue: the 404 page has conflicting robots/googlebot meta tags.

ui_bugs.issue: The title 'Kraków Tour Operator & Private Poland Tours | Green Continent' is 61 characters, over the 60-character limit. It is also the truncated brand ('Green Continent' without 'Tours'). Options: 'Kraków Tour Operator & Private Poland Tours | GCT Tours' or remove one word.

integration_issues.issue: Helmet adds <meta name=robots content='noindex, follow'>, but the static index.html tags <meta name=robots content='index, follow, max-image-preview...'> and <meta name=googlebot content='index, follow'> stay in the head. The page ends up with 2 conflicting robots tags and a googlebot 'index'. Google applies the most restrictive rule, so this probably still works, but it is ambiguous. Fix: remove the static robots/googlebot tags from index.html (or manage them through Helmet with defaults), or also set googlebot noindex in SEO.jsx when noindex is true.

issues: The 'Go to homepage' (no border) and 'Our services' (border-2) buttons differ in height by about 4px side by side. Minor; pre-existing button styles.

action_items: Shorten the Home title to 60 characters or fewer (currently 61)
On the noindex 404 page, make sure no static 'index, follow' robots/googlebot meta remains (index.html lines 61-62)
Optional: og:url / twitter:url on the 404 page point to https://www.greencontinenttours.com/404. Consider omitting them when noindex is set.
Optional: delete the stale comment '<!-- Structured data: BreadcrumbList & SiteNavigationElement -->' near the end of index.html (comment only, no schema)
critical_code_review_comments: SEO.jsx breadcrumb name falls back to title.split(/ [|–] /)[0]. Titles separated by a colon keep the full SEO title as the crumb name, e.g. '3 Days in Kraków: Perfect Itinerary & Local Tips' and 'What to Avoid in Poland: 10 Tourist Mistakes & Scams'. This is valid but long. Pass a short `crumb` prop to these articles.
The SPA fallback in .htaccess returns HTTP 200 for unknown URLs (soft 404). The noindex mitigates this, which is acceptable for a static SPA on one.com.
The /travel-guide/not-real route goes through the GuideArticle CMS fetch, which logs a 404 resource error in the console before NotFound renders. This is expected, with no functional impact.
The 3-days-in-krakow article hero has no srcset (only one 229KB webp). The other articles (e.g. halal) use 1280w/2560w. Optional mobile speed improvement.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (1 of ~25 checks failed: Home title 61 chars)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified at http://localhost:3000. All 12 routes: exactly 1 H1; canonical present; all ld+json parse; inner pages have BreadcrumbList (articles Home>Travel Guide>X, others Home>X). Titles are all 60 or fewer except Home (61). The 404 page (data-testid not-found-page) shows on /some-old-page and /travel-guide/not-real with the URL kept, noindex and no canonical; its RelatedGuides and home/services buttons work. /travel-guide/group-tours goes to /services. index.html has one @graph (TravelAgency #organization + WebSite) and no ItemList; logo-512.png returns 200. Services: H1 correct, 6 services-detail-* blocks, 3 links work, ItemList of 6 Service. Home: home-services-links has 6 links that all navigate correctly. Reviews: 5 cards (3+2) across 2 dots; 'Rated 5.0 on Google · Read all 12 reviews' links to Maps. Hero images: -960.webp on desktop, -m.webp on mobile; slots use -400.webp at both viewports. No broken images on /, /services or halal at either viewport. No horizontal overflow at 390 on /, /services, halal or 404. The only console errors are the dev WebSocket (ws://localhost:443) and the expected CMS 404. Use domcontentloaded plus waits; use a fresh browser context for srcset checks (cache skews currentSrc).
